name: AgentReady
summary: AgentReady is an open specification of what a product should implement to be usable by AI agents. Practices are grouped into find, read and act stages, each with a stable ID (such as AR-FIND-01) and a MUST, SHOULD or MAY strength. The spec itself does not score sites; separate tools such as Ora, is-agentic.com and Mintlify's Agent Score do.
facts: Ora, Vercel, Mintlify, Auth0, Stripe, Tavily
goodFor: A vendor-neutral checklist for agent readiness
Teams that want a spec rather than a score
watchOut: Very new; versions are changing quickly
Research comes mainly from one company (Ora)
